name: Hreflang Tags Pro
author: unbrandedmanchester

sections.description:
Welcome to Hreflang Tag Pro, the streamlined solution for managing international SEO on your WordPress website.

This plugin allows users to effortlessly add, edit, and manage hreflang tags on individual WordPress pages and posts directly from within the WordPress admin.

Powerful Centralised Management
If you manage multiple websites, Hreflang Tag Pro seamlessly connects to our bespoke management platform at hreflangtagspro.com. By generating an API key in your account and adding it to the plugin settings, you can manage, compare, and update hreflang tags across all your connected sites from one intuitive central dashboard.

External services

This plugin can optionally connect to the Hreflang Tag Pro API to sync your data with your central dashboard at hreflangtagspro.com.

If you choose to connect your site using an API key, the following information is synced with the API:
– Your API Key
– Your Website URL
– Post/Page URLs, language/region codes, and their associated hreflang tag data

This connection allows for the seamless management, comparison, and updating of tags across multiple sites directly from your centralised hreflangtagspro.com account. No personal user data (such as emails or passwords) is sent to the API.

Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
How to install the Hreflang Tag Pro Plugin:

  1. Upload the hreflang-tag-pro folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. (Optional for central management) Log in to your account at hreflangtagspro.com and generate your API key for this site
  4. Navigate to the Hreflang Tag Pro settings menu in WordPress
  5. Copy and paste your API Key into the field provided
  6. That’s it! You can now manage tags locally on your posts/pages, or centrally via your Hreflang Tag Pro dashboard
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for this plugin?

The plugin itself is free to use for local, on-site management. Connecting to our bespoke dashboard for multi-site management requires an account at hreflangtagspro.com. There is a free version for smaller networks, and a paid version for networks with more than 3 connected websites.

Do I have to connect to the external dashboard?

No, you can use the plugin as a standalone tool to add and amend hreflang tags directly within your WordPress admin on individual posts and pages.
